interpolate_tracklets_forward: run InterpolateTracklets forward to interpolate disconnected bounding box tracks across video frames
interpolate_tracklets_gsi: apply gaussian smoothed interpolation to tracking bounding boxes using GaussianProcessRegressor
interpolate_tracklets_linear: interpolate a single track linearly to fill gaps between disconnected frames
review_InterpolateTracklets: review the InterpolateTracklets class and its linear interpolation and GSI methods
build_tracking_interpolation: build a multi-object tracking post-processor that fills gaps in tracklets with linear or GSI interpolation
